fusions.name: Seed Pellet
fusions.desc: Fires a seed that deals 4 damage, with a 15% chance of leaving the target [Pinned] for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Rooting Salvo
fusions.desc: Every enemy within 3 tiles takes 12 damage and has a 50% chance of [Pinned] for 2 seconds. Your afflictions on them spread to enemies within 4 tiles.

fusions.name: Sprouting Emplacement
fusions.desc: Restores 3 health a second to you for 8 seconds. A turret of vines fights beside you for 12 seconds, striking for 3 every 1.4 seconds.

fusions.name: Steady Growth
fusions.desc: Your critical strike chance rises by 8%. It also regenerates 1 health a second, permanently.
